by: the independent fixture writer, from each template's JSON (nodes, parameters, connections, description) and n8n's docs, before reading the analyzer's report for these templates
selection: node evals/bench/pick-labels.mjs: round-robin over the refusal pool's buckets (replaced, setup-only, keep-in-n8n, hosted:key, hosted:no-key), most-viewed first, ids printed without verdicts

convention.outcome: the right outcome under the PLAN's default for each question the file cannot settle (chat-app users: outsiders; endpoint callers: outsiders; MCP only client: yes; sub-workflow id: not this workflow; writes: assumed writes)
convention.blockers: blocker kinds (report.schema.json vocabulary) the workflow should get; [] = none
convention.questions: question kinds the analyzer must ask (their answer can change the outcome)
convention.mayAsk: question kinds that are fine to ask but do not change this outcome
convention.ifAnswered: what the outcome becomes if the person gives the answer the file suggests

priorExposure: Before labelling, the writer had seen analyzer outcomes for 1750, 2462 and 2465 (rows 2-4 of corpus.json, seen while checking its format) and RECONCILE.md lines naming 2466 and 4110 (llm-api), 2606 (unconnected HTTP node) and 2982 (LangChain Code node). All 20 are non-subscription by construction of the pool.
docs: https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/builtin/app-nodes/n8n-nodes-base.gmail/message-operations/ (send a message and wait for approval: execution pauses until the recipient approves; fetched 2026-11-14)

PLAN.md decisions: chat-app relays, MCP server replaced, n8n API node blocked, Wait nodes that resume on a webhook out of scope, sub-workflows missing from the export out of scope, llm-api substitution

labels.why: Webhook (responseNode) returns an .xlsx built by Spreadsheet File; the caller waits; no model step
reads every workflow through the n8n API node (blocked by decision); the backup has no meaning without n8n. Not setup-only: it writes files to GitHub and posts to Slack
Webhook → Set → Respond to Webhook text; synchronous, no model. It is also one of n8n's own quick-start lessons; the exclusion rules did not catch it (should have been `hand`)
Telegram bot: OpenAI chat and image replies to whoever messages it; users wait for the reply
API endpoint: validates body, POSTs to ElevenLabs TTS with a stored credential, returns the audio binary. No Claude model (TTS is a media call); the ElevenLabs POST is effectively a read

WhatsApp Cloud API pushes webhooks (no polling API), so the message branch needs a public listener. That branch only appends to a sheet; replies go out from an every-minute schedule (local task only) and a 5-minute Sheets poll. No model anywhere
labels.ifAnswered: nobody waits → cloud-task via a relay; schedule and poll → local-task

labels.why: Telegram personal assistant: voice transcription, agent with Gmail, Calendar and Baserow tools, reply to the sender. The AllowList node suggests one user but the file cannot settle it
WhatsApp sales agent for customers; agent answer awaited. The manual branch fills an in-memory vector store that the chat branch reads (process memory: needs a real vector store)
WhatsApp agent 'made available to the public' (its system message). The two Gemini HTTP calls transcribe audio and describe video: media through the provider, not model calls Claude could take over

the agent's only tool calls workflow N9DveO781xbNf8qs ('Youtube Search Workflow'), which is not in the export. Its nodes are pasted on this canvas without their Execute Workflow Trigger, so even 'this workflow' would not run
community node n8n-nodes-youtube-transcription on the main path (the description says so). Without it: hosted key (synchronous webhook with a model step)

plain Webhooks for WhatsApp: a GET that must echo hub.challenge synchronously, and a POST whose agent replies to the sender's number. Customers wait for answers. Manual branch writes to Qdrant over HTTP

the ingest branch has a LangChain Code node (custom JS with a model attached) and a Telegram send-and-wait approval that resumes on n8n's webhook (out of scope). The chat branch alone would be a skill
agent tool calls hard-coded workflow a2BIIjr2gLBay06M. The file has an Execute Workflow Trigger with the same three inputs, so it very likely points to itself, but ids are not settled by a template
Gmail send-and-wait approval (45 min) pauses the run until a link back to n8n is clicked: a wait that resumes on a webhook. A v2 lever could swap it for an in-page confirmation (substitution)
same Gmail send-and-wait approval before publishing; self-calls by $workflow.id are fine. In a chat skill the approval could become a question in the session (substitution, not v1)

two MCP Server Triggers (Calendar tools, custom functions) whose only client in the file is n8n's own chat agent; Claude with the Calendar connector is the replacement. Also a tutorial in tone ('Learn how to build an MCP Server')
MCP Server Trigger exposing Gmail, Calendar and Sheets tools to an n8n chat agent; Claude's own connectors replace it (Sheets has no captured connector: http with a secret)

Telegram message with a TikTok URL starts a long pipeline (RapidAPI, OpenAI vision and transcription, Perplexity, Captions.ai, JSON2Video, Blotato to 9 platforms) and replies to the chat. Perplexity over HTTP is an LLM call: substitution to Claude needs approval (it loses web search)
